en.headline: Fire Services seize 7,984 litres of diesel at Kwu Tung site
en.dek: A task force targeting illegal refuelling found an unlicensed filling point on Kwu Tung Road on Monday and will prosecute two men under fire-hazard and dangerous-goods laws.
body: The Fire Services Department said its task force against illegal fuel transfer found an unlicensed filling point on Kwu Tung Road during an operation in the Yuen Long district on Monday and seized 7,984 litres of diesel.

The department said the haul was enough to fill the tanks of about 40 medium goods vehicles and had a market value of about HK$292,000. Officers also seized a large quantity of refuelling equipment and intercepted two men suspected of being connected with the site. They are to be prosecuted under the Fire Services (Fire Hazard Abatement) Regulation, the Dangerous Goods Ordinance and the Dangerous Goods (Control) Regulation. The diesel has been removed and the department will apply to the court for forfeiture.

Under the fire-hazard regulation, anyone who possesses or controls a controlled substance on premises for the purpose of transferring it into a vehicle tank commits an offence. A first conviction carries a maximum fine of HK$100,000 and six months' imprisonment; a subsequent conviction can bring a HK$200,000 fine and one year's imprisonment.

The department said illegal filling points are not built to recognised safety standards and lack the fire-service installations required at licensed stations. It asked the public not to use them and to report suspected activity through the Fire Hazard e-Complaint Platform or the 24-hour hotline 5577 9666.

zh.headline: 消防古洞路搗非法油站 檢近8,000公升柴油
zh.dek: 消防處打擊非法燃油轉注特遣隊周一在古洞路發現非法加油站，檢獲7,984公升柴油，市值約29.2萬元，兩名男子將被檢控。
body: 消防處表示，打擊非法燃油轉注特遣隊周一在元朗區行動期間，於古洞路搗破一個非法加油站，檢獲7,984公升柴油。
處方指檢獲柴油約可供注滿40輛中型貨車油缸，市值約29.2萬元。人員並檢走大批入油工具，截查兩名懸疑涉案男子，將根據《消防（消除火警危險）規例》、《危險品條例》及《危險品（管制）規例》提出檢控。涉案柴油已被檢走，消防處會向法庭申請充公。
根據《消防（消除火警危險）規例》，任何人為向汽車油缸轉注受管制物質而在處所管有或控制該等物質，即屬犯罪。首次定罪最高罰款10萬元及監禁6個月，其後每次定罪可罰20萬元及監禁1年。
消防處指非法油站並非按公認安全標準興建，亦無加油站專用消防裝置，一旦失火可造成嚴重後果，呼籲市民勿光顧，並可經火警危險電子投訴平台或24小時熱線5577 9666舉報。
